title: Alligator

fields.name: Alligator
fields.description: A large semi-aquatic reptile with a powerful bite. Alligators are slow on land, but deadly in the water.

intro: An alligator is a large carnivorous animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Alpaca

fields.name: Alpaca
fields.description: A medium-sized ungulate closely related to the llama, the alpaca is usually raised for its remarkably soft and insulating wool. Alpacas have also been used as pack animals since they hauled cargo on the rugged mountain trails of ancient South America.

intro: Alpacas are easily tameable herbivores that provide wool and act as pack animals.

title: Alpha thrumbo

fields.name: Alpha thrumbo
fields.description: A gigantic, graceful creature of unknown origin. Alpha thrumbos are even rarer and more dangerous than the typical thrumbo. Their hide is nearly impossible to pierce and their razor-sharp horn is worth more than its weight in gold. ; Alpha thrumbos are some of the longest-lived moving creatures in the known universe. Some tribes believe they remember and psychically pass on everything they ever experience to their young, so each one has a memory going back thousands of years.

intro: An alpha thrumbo, called an alpha thrumbo calf as a baby, is a powerful animal added by the Odyssey DLC. As the name implies, it is a rarer, more powerful version of the thrumbo.

title: Alphabeaver

fields.name: Alphabeaver
fields.description: A large beaver-like creature genetically engineered to harvest wood with machine-like efficiency. In the absence of specialized feed, these animals will enter a manic state that compels them to eat trees whole, and are likely to attack if disturbed.

intro: Wild alphabeavers can only appear in the Alphabeavers event, which itself only appears in the arid shrubland and tundra. This event requires that the temperature be above the alphabeaver's minimum comfortable temperature of temperature|. The amount of beavers scales with a colony's raid points.

title: Arctic fox

fields.name: Arctic fox
fields.description: A small predator adapted for cold climates. It usually hunts small game like mice and voles, sometimes burrowing through a meter of snow to reach its prey.

intro: Arctic foxes, called arctic fox puppies as babies, are small, carnivorous animals. They are one of several different types of fox.

title: Arctic wolf

fields.name: Arctic wolf
fields.description: An arctic variant of the old Earth wolf. As pack hunters, wolves have a complex social life and are fiercely intelligent.

intro: Arctic wolves, called arctic wolf puppies as babies, are pack hunters but are often seen alone or in pairs in-game. They are almost identical to timber wolves, differing only in habitat, resistance to cold temperatures and coloration.

title: Armadillo

fields.name: Armadillo
fields.description: A small mammal with leathery armor all over its body. It is surprisingly quick for a creature with such stubby legs.

intro: An armadillo is a small armored animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Badger

fields.name: Badger
fields.description: A stocky omnivorous mammal. Badgers are surprisingly tough for their size.

intro: A badger is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Barkskin dryad

fields.name: Barkskin dryad
fields.description: A dryad caste specialized in absorbing hits during combat. Barkskin dryads are covered by a thick bark-like hide which is partly formed by the Gauranlen tree itself. Under human influence, it can act as a damage-absorbing fighter.; In general, dryads are mammal-like creatures that have a symbiotic relationship with the Gauranlen tree. They reproduce together with their tree, which contains a hidden dryad queen. Dryads can morph into various specialized castes.

intro: Barkskin dryads are a caste of Dryads, a type of animal added by the Ideology DLC. Slow but tough, the barkskin dryad soaks hits for your other fighters.

title: Berrymaker dryad

fields.name: Berrymaker dryad
fields.description: A dryad caste specialized in food production. Together with its Gauranlen tree, this dryad can generate nourishing berries on an ongoing basis. However, it is slow and ineffective at work or combat.; In general, dryads are mammal-like creatures that have a symbiotic relationship with the Gauranlen tree. They reproduce together with their tree, which contains a hidden dryad queen. Dryads can morph into various specialized castes.

intro: Berrymaker dryads are a caste of Dryads, a type of animal added by the Ideology DLC, that produces berries.

title: Bison

fields.name: Bison
fields.description: A large plant eating mammal appearing in the savannah wilderness. Tamed are quite docile, but enraged are fast and dangerous.

intro: Bison, called bison calves as babies, are large, grazing herbivores that provide wool and act as pack animals.

title: Bluebird

fields.name: Bluebird
fields.description: A small songbird with vibrant blue plumage.

intro: A Bluebird is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Bog hound

fields.name: Bog hound
fields.description: Descended from domesticated dogs, these canines have grown unaccustomed to human company. They're skilled scavengers, able to survive in extremely toxic environments. Bog hounds are harder to tame than their domesticated cousins, and much more dangerous.

intro: A bog hound is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Boomalope

fields.name: Boomalope
fields.description: Engineered for chemicals production, the boomalope grows a large sac of volatile chemicals on its back. Though it is weak and fragile for its size, other animals have learned to avoid it because of the huge explosion it produces when it dies. It can be milked to produce chemfuel - very carefully.

intro: Boomalopes, called boomalope calves when babies, are herbivores with a high hunger rate. They produce chemfuel per day, and explode on death.

title: Boomrat

fields.name: Boomrat
fields.description: Either by deliberate genetic weaponization, or as an unusual defense mechanism, these rodent-like creatures create a powerful fire-starting explosion when killed.

intro: Boomrats can be found in . They can either be tamed by a handler or self-tame in a random event.

title: Bullfrog

fields.name: Bullfrog
fields.description: A large frog known for its loud croak. Bullfrog legs are a delicacy on some planets.

intro: A bullfrog is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Capybara

fields.name: Capybara
fields.description: The largest natural rodent, the capybara is well-adapted for steaming jungle environments.

intro: Capybaras are difficult to tame herbivores.

title: Caribou

fields.name: Caribou
fields.description: A large member of the deer family, well-adapted to life in cold climates. Caribou can be milked, but refuse to carry packs.

intro: The Caribou, called caribou calves as babies, is a large herbivorous animal that provides meat, plainleather and, if tamed, milk.

title: Carrier dryad

fields.name: Carrier dryad
fields.description: A dryad caste specialized in carrying items. Under human influence, it can help haul things where they need to go.; In general, dryads are mammal-like creatures that have a symbiotic relationship with the Gauranlen tree. They reproduce together with their tree, which contains a hidden dryad queen. Dryads can morph into various specialized castes.

intro: Carrier dryads are a caste of Dryads, a type of animal added by the Ideology DLC. These chunky helpers will haul things where they need to go.

title: Cassowary

fields.name: Cassowary
fields.description: A large flightless bird with brightly-colored feathers. While it looks beautiful, its kick is vicious. It's known for being quick to aggression when harmed by violence or confronted by incompetent animal tamers.

intro: The Cassowary is a large, flightless bird found in .

title: Cat

fields.name: Cat
fields.description: One of mankind's first pets, the cat is a small mammal which hunts vermin. Known for their aloofness, cats are nevertheless popular companions because of their independence, calm disposition, and fine, pettable fur.

intro: Cats, called kittens as babies, are small carnivorous animals. Unsurprisingly, you can't get them to do anything. On the upside, they don't eat much, and cheer up your colonists with their nuzzles.

title: Chicken

fields.name: Chicken
fields.description: The most traditional farm bird, the chicken is raised for its eggs and meat. It grows very quickly and lays eggs very often.

intro: Chickens are domesticated egg-laying animals. Males of the species are referred to as Cockerels as adolescents and Roosters as adults and can be distinguished by their ruddy brown coloration, while females are referred to as Hens and are white. Babies of either gender are bright yellow and referred to as Chicks.

title: Chinchilla

fields.name: Chinchilla
fields.description: A small, nimble rodent. Its fur is softer than just about anything in the universe, making it very valuable as a trade good.

intro: Chinchillas can be found in they can either be tamed by a handler or self-tame in a random event.

title: Clawer dryad

fields.name: Clawer dryad
fields.description: A dryad caste with huge claws that is specialized in aggression and damage-dealing attacks. Though it can do tremendous damage, it is vulnerable to attacks itself.; In general, dryads are mammal-like creatures that have a symbiotic relationship with the Gauranlen tree. They reproduce together with their tree, which contains a hidden dryad queen. Dryads can morph into various specialized castes.

intro: Clawer dryads are a caste of Dryads, a type of animal added by the Ideology DLC. Vulnerable but fearsome, the clawer dryad specializes in damage dealing.

title: Cobra

fields.name: Cobra
fields.description: A large predatory snake. Cobras can be highly aggressive if provoked, and their bite injects toxic venom into the victim.

intro: Cobras are predatory and ovivorous snakes found in . They eat smaller animals, and sometimes people if they don't find a smaller prey in time.

title: Colossus toad

fields.name: Colossus toad
fields.description: A massive frog bioengineered for industrial farms. While safe to eat, its thick skin secretes an unpleasant slime.

intro: A colossus toad is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Cougar

fields.name: Cougar
fields.description: One of the most dangerous big cats, cougars are solitary hunters with long, sharp teeth and claws. They stalk prey from hidden positions before pouncing.; While humans are not their normal diet, they won't turn down a meal of vulnerable human meat.

intro: The cougar is a large feline predator. They are solitary hunters that can be found in . If forced to, or when particularly hungry, they are one of the fiercer wild creatures your colonists can face.

title: Cow

fields.name: Cow
fields.description: A large domesticated ungulate, cows have been bred for millennia to produce huge amounts of milk, meat, and leather. They are exceptionally gentle creatures and will never seek revenge, no matter how many times they are harmed. Most of them are so adapted to farm life that they cannot survive in the wild.

intro: Cows do not spawn as wild animals. Instead they must be purchased from a trader or faction base, or join the colony in an Animals join events.

title: Crow

fields.name: Crow
fields.description: Intelligent black birds with complex social structures. With a little patience, crows can be tamed to perform a number of fairly complex tasks.

intro: A Crow is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Deer

fields.name: Deer
fields.description: A medium-sized herding herbivore which prefers to live in mixed forests and plains. Deer are very quick.

intro: Deer can be found in . They can either be tamed by a handler or self-tame in a random event.

title: Donkey

fields.name: Donkey
fields.description: A small relative of the horse, domesticated in ancient times for farm work. Its goofy call is simultaneously annoying and endearing.; When in a caravan, people can ride donkeys to increase the caravan's speed.

intro: Donkeys, called donkey foals as babies, are tameable herbivores that can be both ridden in caravans and act as a pack animal.

title: Dromedary

fields.name: Dromedary
fields.description: A large land mammal adapted to arid environments. Domesticated since ancient times, its wool and leather are both exceptionally good at insulating against the desert heat, and its milk is quite nourishing. It can be used as a pack animal and mount, but its bouncing gait makes it slower to ride than a horse.; By storing water in its large humps and reclaiming moisture from its breath as it exhales, it can go weeks without drinking.; When in a caravan, people can ride dromedaries to increase the caravan's speed.

intro: Dromedaries, called dromedary calves as babies, are desert-dwelling herbivores that provide milk and act as pack animals.

title: Duck

fields.name: Duck
fields.description: A very common type of farm bird, also appearing in the wild, the duck is raised for its delicious meat. It grows quick but lays eggs quite rarely.

intro: Ducks (or ducklings for young ducks) are small, domesticated waterfowl. Like chickens, ducks mature quickly and lay eggs often, making them both good meal birds and sources of eggs. Males of the species can be distinguished by their green heads and two-tone body while females have a solid colour head and body with darker wings.

title: Elephant

fields.name: Elephant
fields.description: The largest unmodified land animal. Elephants have a long trunk they use to manipulate objects, and sharp tusks they use to gore attackers. A dead elephant's valuable tusks can be recovered by butchering it.; Intelligent creatures with complex social relationships, elephants can be used as pack animals or trained to carry out the most complex of tasks. They live a long time, and are known to remember events and relationships from many decades before.

intro: Elephants, called elephant calves as babies, are large land animals often found in . They have elephant tusks, which they use to fight in melee.

title: Elk

fields.name: Elk
fields.description: A large member of the deer family, well-adapted to life in cold climates. Domesticated elk can be milked, but refuse to carry packs.

intro: Elk, called elk calves as babies, are a large species of herbivore that appear in herds. They have a muffalo's tolerance to subzero temperatures so they are quite comfortable living in the cold biomes.

title: Emu

fields.name: Emu
fields.description: A large flightless bird with beady eyes on its ugly face. With its bad attitude, it is the jerk of the natural world. Bother it, and it is guaranteed to seek revenge.

intro: The Emu is a large, flightless and incredibly aggressive bird found in .

title: Fennec fox

fields.name: Fennec fox
fields.description: A small fox originally from the northern part of Earth's Africa continent. It hunts small creatures and has very large ears for cooling itself in the heat.

intro: Fennec foxes, called fennec fox puppies as babies, are small, carnivorous animals. They are one of several different types of fox.

title: Flamingo

fields.name: Flamingo
fields.description: A wading bird known for their vibrant pink plumage. Their long legs are well adapted to shallow waters.

intro: A Flamingo is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Gaumaker dryad

fields.name: Gaumaker dryad
fields.description: A dryad caste with the unique ability to produce new Gauranlen pods and reproduce the Gauranlen tree along with its symbiote, the dryad queen. To do this, three gaumaker dryads must slowly merge.; In general, dryads are mammal-like creatures that have a symbiotic relationship with the Gauranlen tree. They reproduce together with their tree, which contains a hidden dryad queen. Dryads can morph into various specialized castes.

intro: Gaumaker dryad are a caste of dryads, a type of animal added by the Ideology DLC that produces Gauranlen sprouts to make new Gauranlen trees.

title: Gazelle

fields.name: Gazelle
fields.description: A small, extremely quick antelope known for its amazingly long leap.

intro: The gazelle is a herbivorous animal native to .

title: Goat

fields.name: Goat
fields.description: Naturally curious about the world, goats are among the friendliest domesticated creature bred by mankind.

intro: Goats, called Goat does if female and baby goats as babies, are tameable milk-producing herbivores with a medium movement speed. Adult males of the species can be distinguished by their dark accents and horns, while females and babies of either gender lack horns and have a more consistent coat color. Despite the visual differences, adults of both genders have the same stats and attacks.

title: Goose

fields.name: Goose
fields.description: A domesticated bird kept by humans as poultry for it's eggs and meat. Lays eggs very often, however they take a long time to hatch.

intro: A Goose is a domesticated, medium-sized waterfowl, known for its large eggs and belligerent nature. Like all farm animals geese cannot be found in the wild, and must be purchased from traders.

title: Gorilla

fields.name: Gorilla
fields.description: A massive and intelligent great ape. While generally peaceful, gorillas are terrifying when enraged.

intro: A gorilla is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Greatwolf

fields.name: Greatwolf
fields.description: A genetically engineered canine modeled on long-extinct dire wolves. These fearsome predators were created as pets for the glitterworld elite. Wild greatwolves now populate many planets, due to their tendency to escape confinement.

intro: A greatwolf, called greatwolf puppy as a baby, is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC. It is similar to the timber wolf and arctic wolf but almost twice their size. It is also wilder, faster and hungrier.

title: Grizzly bear

fields.name: Grizzly bear
fields.description: A huge omnivorous mammal adapted for cold climates. Bears' thick blubber and fur keeps them warm in winter.; While their usual diet consists of fish, berries, honey, and scavenged meat, the grizzly is capable of using its massive strength and deadly claws to kill live prey. They are startlingly quick for such lumbering creatures.

intro: Grizzly bears are huge solitary omnivores found in .

title: Guinea pig

fields.name: Guinea pig
fields.description: Neither a pig or a creature from Guinea, these little rodents are bred to be a household pet and a delicious dinner.

intro: Guinea pigs are tameable herbivores with a fast movement speed. Guinea Pigs come in three colors: Cream, Black and Brown.

title: Hare

fields.name: Hare
fields.description: This small, solitary herbivore can swiftly hop away from danger.

intro: They are effectively identical to the snowhare, only differing in habitat, comfortable temperature range, and color.

title: Hermit crab

fields.name: Hermit crab
fields.description: A small crustacean found along coastlines. Hermit crabs scavenge various shells to protect themselves.

intro: A hermit crab is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Heron

fields.name: Heron
fields.description: Long-legged and long-necked birds. They tend to live in marshy habitats.

intro: A Heron is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Hippo

fields.name: Hippo
fields.description: An enormous semi-aquatic mammal with short stocky legs. While it is a herbivore, it can attack with devastating force if provoked. Its powerful jaw can crush bone and armor.

intro: A hippo is a large, dangerous, and incredibly filthy animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Hive queen

fields.name: Hive queen
fields.description: The birth mother of an insect megahive. Under suitable conditions, several distinct insect hives will merge together and produce a hive queen. The queen quickly grows in size, becoming trapped in her own burrow.

intro: A Hive queen is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Horse

fields.name: Horse
fields.description: A large hoofed mammal with a short coat, a long mane, and a long tail. Horses have been domesticated since ancient times.; When in a caravan, people can ride horses to increase the caravan's speed.

intro: Horses, called Mares if female and Stallions if male and foals as babies, are tameable herbivores with a fast movement speed.

title: Human

fields.name: Human
fields.description: A baseline human, mostly unmodified by gene engineering and mostly unchanged by evolutionary pressures on non-Earth planets.

intro: Humans are the primary inhabitants of the Rimworlds and the foundation of—if not the whole of—player colonies, as well as the only known sapient species in the universe of RimWorld.

title: Husky

fields.name: Husky
fields.description: A large, energetic dog with a thick fur coat for remaining comfortable in arctic environments.

intro: Huskies, like labrador retrievers, can periodically haul items and rescue downed pawns, making them useful pets to have.

title: Ibex

fields.name: Ibex
fields.description: The wild ancestor of the domesticated goat. Ibexes live on marginal territory where most antelopes couldn't survive, eating lichens and sparse mountain plants. They're famous for dextrously hopping across bare cliff faces - and for their violent ramming attack.

intro: The ibex is a large wild goat. Males of the species are called Ibex rams and have large rounded horns and a darker brown color, while females are called ibex does and have shorter, straighter horns and a lighter brown color. Despite the visual differences, adult ibex of both genders have the same stats and attacks.

title: Iguana

fields.name: Iguana
fields.description: These large lizards normally feed on plant matter. However, when angered, their tough hide and sharp claws make them quite dangerous.; Resting iguanas hold their heads high, giving them an amusing 'proud' look. But they're not proud; they're just trying to see predators so they don't get eaten.

intro: Iguanas can be found in . They can either be tamed by a handler or self-tame in a random event.

title: Immature dryad

fields.name: Immature dryad
fields.description: Dryads are small mammalian creatures that have a symbiotic relationship with the Gauranlen tree. This immature dryad can support and protect its tree, but its main purpose is to morph into more specialized and powerful dryad forms.

intro: Immature dyrads are a caste of Dryads, a type of animal added by the Ideology DLC.

title: Labrador retriever

fields.name: Labrador retriever
fields.description: A very versatile, medium-sized dog. Originally bred to retrieve birds shot on the hunt, the lab is also an excellent guard dog, play pal, and family friend.

intro: Labrador retrievers do not spawn as wild animals. Instead they must be purchased from a trader or faction base, or join the colony in an Animals join events.

title: Larva

fields.name: Larva
fields.description: The juvenile form of larger bioengineered insects. Larva maintain and expand hives using an acidic secretion. If provoked, they defend themselves by spewing sludge.

intro: A larva (pl. larvae) is a type of small, sludge-spitting insectoid added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Lava snail

fields.name: Lava snail
fields.description: A large slow-moving mollusk. Originating from the volcanic planet Nuchadus, lava snails were bred as farm animals. Their skin secretes a thick slime that protects them from extreme temperatures.

intro: A lava snail is a slow, armored animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Locust

fields.name: Locust
fields.description: A bioengineered insect capable of flying short distances. Specialized chemical receptors allow locusts to effectively forage for food. While relatively weak on their own, swarms of locusts can be deadly.

intro: A locust is a type of flying insectoid added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Lynx

fields.name: Lynx
fields.description: A wildcat larger than a housecat, but smaller than a cougar. Lynxes survive on a diet of small birds and animals. Their very warm fur keeps them safe from the brutally cold temperatures of their frozen territories.

intro: Lynxes, called lynx kittens as babies, are medium-sized, solitary feline predators found in . Although not too dangerous to a moderately experienced, well-equipped hunter, lynxes can menace livestock and pets, and probably will where food is scarce. Their fur has excellent insulation value.

title: Macaw

fields.name: Macaw
fields.description: A parrot known for its intelligence and its brilliant plumage.

intro: A Macaw is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Mastodon

fields.name: Mastodon
fields.description: A massive elephant-like mammal. While briefly extinct, the mastodon now roams countless worlds due to its resilience to bitter cold. Its thick hide makes excellent cold-weather clothing. However, hunting the animal is a dangerous proposition even for skilled hunters.

intro: A Mastodon is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Medicinemaker dryad

fields.name: Medicinemaker dryad
fields.description: A dryad caste specialized in medicine production. Together with its Gauranlen tree, this dryad can generate medicinal herbs on an ongoing basis. However, it is slow and ineffective at work or combat.; In general, dryads are mammal-like creatures that have a symbiotic relationship with the Gauranlen tree. They reproduce together with their tree, which contains a hidden dryad queen. Dryads can morph into various specialized castes.

intro: Medicinemaker dryads are a caste of Dryads, a type of animal added by the Ideology DLC that generates herbal medicine x4 every two days.

title: Megascarab

fields.name: Megascarab
fields.description: A large, genetically-engineered beetle. Once the worker caste of an artificial ecosystem of insectoids designed to fight mechanoid invasions, it is now often seen without its deadlier insectoid cousins. Still, its size and hard shell make it dangerous when it attacks. A eusocial creature, it cannot reproduce individually.
fields.label: megascarab

intro: Megascarabs are a type of Insectoid.

title: Megasloth

fields.name: Megasloth
fields.description: A giant, solitary herbivore with two giant claws for warding off threats. Long extinct after being wiped out by the natives of Earth's American continent, the megasloth was later brought back using advanced cloning and artificial gestators. Its thick hide is exceptionally strong and insulating, and makes a great leather for cold-weather clothing. It is peaceful if left alone, but will shred anyone who disturbs it with its giant claws.

intro: The megasloth is a giant, ancient sloth. Megasloths can be found in .

title: Megaspider

fields.name: Megaspider
fields.description: Not actually a spider, the megaspider is a genetically-engineered giant insectoid the size of a bear. Designed for heavy work and combat, its thick chitinous armor makes it hard to kill, while its long ripper-blades make it deadly at close quarters. It is, however, quite slow in open terrain.
fields.label: megaspider

intro: Megaspiders are giant, bio-engineered, subterranean invertebrates and the largest and most dangerous of the three insectoid types.

title: Megavole

fields.name: Megavole
fields.description: A massive burrowing rodent, bred for its size and strength. It's almost completely blind but can be surprisingly aggressive when cornered. On some low-tech worlds, these creatures are trained to dig for valuable minerals.

intro: A megavole is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Mink

fields.name: Mink
fields.description: A small semi-aquatic mammal. The high value of its fur has resulted in mink being farmed on numerous planets.

intro: A Mink is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Monitor lizard

fields.name: Monitor lizard
fields.description: A large venomous lizard. They secrete toxins from venom glands in their lower jaw to neutralize their prey.

intro: A monitor lizard is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Monkey

fields.name: Monkey
fields.description: A small primate, the monkey can use its curly tail to grab on to branches, leaving its hands free to do other things. Monkeys are selfish but clever, and can be trained to carry out fairly complex tasks.

intro: Monkeys can be found in . They can either be tamed by a handler or self-tame in a random event.

title: Moose

fields.name: Moose
fields.description: One of the largest members of the deer family, adapted to extremely cold climates. Its long legs allow it to travel easily through deep snow.

intro: Moose, called moose calves as babies, are a type of animal added by the Odyssey DLC. Adult males of the species can be distinguished by their large antlers, while females and calves of either gender lack them. Despite the visual differences, adults of both genders have the same stats and attacks.

title: Muffalo

fields.name: Muffalo
fields.description: A large herding herbivore descended from buffalo and adapted for both cold and warm environments. While enraged muffalo are deadly, tamed muffalo are quite docile and can be used as pack animals.; Nobody is quite sure why they're blue - it might even be some early genetic modification test that just never got changed.

intro: Muffalo are slow-moving, grass-grazing quadrupeds analogous to buffalo.

title: Muskox

fields.name: Muskox
fields.description: A shaggy hoofed mammal found in colder climates. Muskox wool is known for being scratchy, but offers good protection against the cold.

intro: A muskox (pl. muskoxen), called a muskox calf as a baby, is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Ostrich

fields.name: Ostrich
fields.description: The largest unmodified bird species, ostriches are known for their fast run, huge eggs, and powerful kick. It is easily angered.

intro: Ostriches are huge, flightless birds that are easily riled, found in arid shrublands and deserts. Male adult ostriches are dark, while young (baby and juvenile) and female ostriches are lighter brown.

title: Otter

fields.name: Otter
fields.description: A playful marine creature. They use tools such as rocks to crack open shellfish.

intro: An otter is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Panda

fields.name: Panda
fields.description: A slow lumbering herbivore. Pandas are admired by many for their clumsy charm, making them common pets on urbworlds. On the rim, pandas are rarely seen outside of captivity.

intro: A panda is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Panther

fields.name: Panther
fields.description: An agile and powerful big cat native to the jungles of old Earth. As solitary ambush predators, panthers are masters of taking down both large and small prey. Onlookers tend to focus on their graceful movements, while those in closer contact usually notice their skull-crushing strength.

intro: Panthers are medium-sized predators, and good guardians when tamed.

title: Peafowl

fields.name: Peafowl
fields.description: Large birds with extravagant plumage. Male peacocks use their tail feathers in elaborate courtship displays.

intro: Peafowl, called peacocks when male and peahens when female, are animals added by the Odyssey DLC. Males of the species can be distinguished by their vibrant blue coloration and their large, green, fanned tails, while females, called peahens, are largely brown, with a dark green neck and lack any pronounced tail.

title: Penguin

fields.name: Penguin
fields.description: A flightless bird adept at surviving in cold regions. Their black and white plumage and waddling gait make them unmistakable. They are deadly hunters in the water, but slow and vulnerable on land.

intro: A Penguin is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Pig

fields.name: Pig
fields.description: Pigs were one of the first animals domesticated by humans. They are an efficient source of meat, and are easy to feed because they will eat almost anything.

intro: Pigs, called sows if female and piglets as babies, are domesticated animals, obtainable from both land and space traders. Pigs are omnivorous, making them easy to feed. They will eat live plants and so should be kept away from the growing zones.

title: Polar bear

fields.name: Polar bear
fields.description: A great white bear adapted for frozen climates. Their thick blubber and fur keep them warm in winter.; While their usual diet consists of fish and scavenged meat, the polar bear can also use its massive strength and deadly claws to kill live prey. They are startlingly quick for such lumbering creatures.

intro: Polar bears are huge solitary omnivores found in . They are identical to a grizzly bear, except for their appearance, habitat, comfortable temperature range, and wildness (85% versus 80% for a grizzly bear).

title: Porcupine

fields.name: Porcupine
fields.description: A large rodent. While slow moving, it has a cloak of sharp quills which protect it from predators.

intro: A porcupine is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Prairie dog

fields.name: Prairie dog
fields.description: A burrowing rodent with a short tail and sharp claws used for digging. They are social animals, often living in large colonies.

intro: A prairie dog is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Quail

fields.name: Quail
fields.description: Small plump ground-dwelling birds with a distinctive plume.

intro: A quail is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC. Males of the species can be distinguished by their blue coloration, black head, yellow belly, and curving crest, while females are a more consistent brown with a slight blue tinge and a shorter, squarer crest.

title: Raccoon

fields.name: Raccoon
fields.description: A small, hardy animal that ranges wide across forests and shrubland. It is happy to break into your garbage container, or your kitchen, to eat almost anything.

intro: Raccoons can be found in . They can either be tamed by a handler or self-tame in a random event.

title: Rat

fields.name: Rat
fields.description: A widely-hated rodent known for soiling kitchens and spreading disease, rats have a way of following humans everywhere they go. It eats almost anything and lives almost anywhere.

intro: Rats can be found in . They can either be tamed by a handler or self-tame in a random event.

title: Red fox

fields.name: Red fox
fields.description: A small solitary canine evolved for hunting small prey in temperate climates. Chicken farmers hate foxes because of their ability to destroy a whole coop in minutes.

intro: Red foxes, called red fox puppies as babies, are small, carnivorous animals. They are one of several different types of fox.

title: Rhinoceros

fields.name: Rhinoceros
fields.description: Despite being herbivorous, this large mammal is very easy to enrage. Once angered, its massive strength and sharp horn make it a brutal opponent. It has more muscle in one leg than most humans do in their whole body.

intro: Rhinoceroses can be found in . They can either be tamed by a handler or self-tame in a random event.

title: Scimitar cat

fields.name: Scimitar cat
fields.description: A bioengineered predator that resembles its long-extinct namesake. Originally bred to populate iceworld hunting reserves, these animals are now common pets among glitterworld socialites. Their ferocity should not be underestimated.

intro: A Scimitar cat is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Sea lion

fields.name: Sea lion
fields.description: A large and intelligent marine animal. Male sea lions have thick fur around their necks, which evoke a lion's mane.

intro: Sea lions, called sea lion pups as babies, are a type of aquatic animal added by the Odyssey DLC. Males of the species can be distinguished by their brown coloration and slightly larger size, while females are a tawny color and slightly smaller. Despite the visual size difference, adults of both genders have the same stats and attacks.

title: Sea turtle

fields.name: Sea turtle
fields.description: A large marine turtle. Their streamlined shell and powerful flippers make them excellent swimmers.

intro: A sea turtle is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Seal

fields.name: Seal
fields.description: A marine mammal with a streamlined body that is adept at hunting fish. While slow on land, seals are relatively quick in water.

intro: Seals, called seal pups as babies, are aquatic animals added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Sheep

fields.name: Sheep
fields.description: Sheep husbandry is practised throughout the majority of the inhabited worlds, however only recently it has been introduced to the rimworlds. Domestic sheep are relatively small herbivores, usually with yellowish wool and medium sized horns.

intro: Sheep are easily tameable herbivores with a medium movement speed. Males of the species are referred to as Rams and can be distinguished by their rounded horns, while females are referred to as Ewes and lack horns. Babies of either gender appear identical to ewes and are referred to as Lambs. Despite the visual differences, adults of both genders have the same stats and attacks.

title: Snowhare

fields.name: Snowhare
fields.description: This hardy animal survives the brutal winters of its homelands by burrowing through snow to find edible plants.

intro: They are effectively identical to the hare, only differing in habitat, comfortable temperature range, and color.

title: Sparrow

fields.name: Sparrow
fields.description: Small birds that often travel in flocks. They can thrive in a variety of environments.

intro: A sparrow is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Spelopede

fields.name: Spelopede
fields.description: A medium-sized bioengineered insectoid the size of a sheep. The spelopede is the middle caste of a hive, taking care of most work tasks as well as fighting with its digging claws. It's dangerous in combat, but slow on open ground.
fields.label: spelopede

intro: Spelopedes are giant, bio-engineered, subterranean invertebrates and the middle of the three insectoid types in both size and danger.

title: Squirrel

fields.name: Squirrel
fields.description: One of the many hardy rodent species that follows humankind everywhere it spreads. Squirrels are distinguished by their bushy tails, which they use as umbrellas in bad weather.

intro: Squirrels can be found in . They can either be tamed by a handler or self-tame in a random event.

title: Stone crab

fields.name: Stone crab
fields.description: A robust crustacean with powerful claws. Stone crabs are a delicacy in some regions.

intro: A Stone crab is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Swan

fields.name: Swan
fields.description: Large graceful waterfowl known for their beauty, and their surprising ferocity.

intro: A Swan is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Thrumbo

fields.name: Thrumbo
fields.description: A gigantic, graceful creature of unknown origin. The thrumbo is gentle by nature, but extremely dangerous when enraged. While its long fur is exceptionally beautiful, its hide is also incredibly resistant to damage. Its razor-sharp horn fetches a huge price.; Legends say that an old thrumbo is the wisest creature in the universe - it simply chooses not to speak.

intro: Thrumbos, called thrumbo calves as babies, are large, powerful animals not native to any biome, instead appearing in all biomes through a random event.

title: Tiger

fields.name: Tiger
fields.description: A solitary and dangerous apex predator. Tigers make quick work of their prey, using a mix of stealth and razor-sharp claws.

intro: A Tiger is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Timber wolf

fields.name: Timber wolf
fields.description: A rugged predator long feared by many ancient Earth cultures. As pack hunters, wolves have complex social lives and are fiercely intelligent.

intro: Timber wolves, called timber wolf puppies as babies, are pack hunters but are often seen alone or in pairs in-game. They are almost identical to arctic wolves, differing only in habitat, resistance to cold temperatures and coloration.

title: Tortoise

fields.name: Tortoise
fields.description: This heavily armored land-dwelling reptile is known for its slow moving speed and surprisingly vicious bite. Because of its natural armor, it is tough to kill and can do serious damage during drawn-out melee fights.

intro: Tortoises can be found in . They can either be tamed by a handler or self-tame in a random event.

title: Toxalope

fields.name: Toxalope
fields.description: A pollution-adapted cousin of the boomalope, the toxalope grows toxic pouches on its back. When it dies, the toxic material explodes and produces a deadly toxic cloud. Unlike the boomalope, the toxalope cannot be milked.

intro: Toxalope, called toxalope calves as babies, are animals added by the Biotech DLC that live in polluted areas and explode into a tox gas cloud upon death.

title: Turkey

fields.name: Turkey
fields.description: A short, fat, flightless bird known for its hilarious 'gobbling' call. It has been long domesticated, but also lives in the wild.

intro: The turkey is a large bird that lays eggs. Adult male turkeys can be distinguished by a red head and neck, blue body, and a large fanned tail while females and babies of both genders are largely brown with a downwards angled tail.

title: Vulture

fields.name: Vulture
fields.description: Scavengers with strong beaks and broad wings. Their strong stomach acid allows them to eat rotting corpses.

intro: A vulture is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Walrus

fields.name: Walrus
fields.description: A large marine animal with tusks and whiskers. Its considerable bulk allows it to survive in extremely cold environments. While slow on land, it is relatively quick in water.

intro: Walruses, call walrus calves as babies, are aquatic animals added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Warg

fields.name: Warg
fields.description: Heavily-muscled wolf-like creatures with vicious unnatural claws and an absurdly powerful bite. They will only eat meat or corpses. If disturbed in the wild, they are very likely to attack.; Scientists say wargs are the descendants of weaponized military animals created for population suppression. The superstitious see them as the tools of an angry god.

intro: Wargs, called warg puppies as babies, are cold-loving, wolf-like carnivorous animals that roam through . While most carnivores can eat meat, corpses, kibble, and meals, Wargs can only eat raw meat and corpses.

title: Waste rat

fields.name: Waste rat
fields.description: A toxin-adapted variant of the common rat. Waste rats have evolved to be pollution-resistant, as well as larger, tougher, and more aggressive than standard rats. Their bite infects their attacker with toxic buildup.

intro: A waste rat is an animal added by the Biotech DLC.

title: Wild boar

fields.name: Wild boar
fields.description: This hairy omnivore is descended from escaped pigs and evolved for living in the wild.; Its tusks make it a better fighter than its domesticated pig cousins. Unfortunately, it is too unruly to be trained in the most complex tasks.

intro: Wild boars can be found in . They can either be tamed by a handler or self-tame in a random event.

title: Wolverine

fields.name: Wolverine
fields.description: A small but ferocious predator. Wolverines are solitary animals that prefer to eat carrion but can kill animals many times their size if needed.

intro: A wolverine is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC.

title: Woodmaker dryad

fields.name: Woodmaker dryad
fields.description: A slow, bumbling caste of dryad which specializes in wood production. Together with its Gauranlen tree, this dryad can generate a wood-like material on an ongoing basis. However, it is slow and ineffective at work or combat.; In general, dryads are mammal-like creatures that have a symbiotic relationship with the Gauranlen tree. They reproduce together with their tree, which contains a hidden dryad queen. Dryads can morph into various specialized castes.

intro: Woodmaker dryads are a caste of Dryads, a type of animal added by the Ideology DLC.

title: Yak

fields.name: Yak
fields.description: Yaks are robust cattle with a bulky frame, short but thick legs, and rounded cloven hooves that are splayed to help them walk in snow.

intro: Yaks, called yak calves as babies, are tameable herbivores with a medium movement speed. Yaks are one of the easiest pack animals to tame. Males of the species can be distinguished by their horns and lack of udders, while females have the opposite. Despite the visual differences, adults of both genders have the same stats and attacks.

title: Yorkshire terrier

fields.name: Yorkshire terrier
fields.description: A small, even-tempered dog. Originally bred to hunt rats, it later became a show and companionship animal. Some consider it useless, but the mood boost it gives by nuzzling can outweigh the cost of feeding it.

intro: Yorkshire terriers do not spawn as wild animals. Instead they must be purchased from a trader or faction base, or join the colony in an Animals join events.
